title: Repair Release history for GitHub publication
goal: Replace the incomplete grafted Release history with a self-contained root history that preserves the current Release tree and source provenance, then publish it to the approved empty origin repository.
doneWhen: Release main has a self-contained Git history with no missing parent object.
The current Release tree and source provenance are preserved.
origin/main is force-updated successfully and matches local main.
decisions: The grafted RLinf base cannot be pushed because its parent object is absent; Release source provenance documents the upstream baseline, so a self-contained Release root commit is preferred over importing unrelated upstream history.
The approved origin is git@github.com:TBLboy/RLinf-Franka.git and may be force-updated because the user confirmed it is empty.

verification.summary: Release was converted to self-contained root commit 52f3232 and force-pushed successfully to origin/main.
checks: Source provenance for RLinf e7a9a2e remains in Release documentation
Git object integrity check completed before publication
limitations: GitHub accepted the 95.41 MB PC Service Debian artifact but warned that it exceeds the 50 MB recommended file size; consider Git LFS for future large resource revisions.
